info.title: Rookery API
info.description: Virtual-machine, storage, network, and VPP management API.

tags.name: SystemService
tags.description: SystemService exposes host and readiness information.

tags.name: MediaService
tags.description: MediaService manages read-only installation media records.

tags.name: NetworkService
tags.description: NetworkService manages VPP bridge domains presented as Rookery Networks.

tags.name: InterfaceService
tags.description: InterfaceService manages VPP vhost-user interfaces and their VM attachment.

tags.name: ACLService
tags.description: ACLService manages ordered interface ingress/egress ACLs.

tags.name: VNFService
tags.description: VNFService manages DHCP and NAT44 network functions.

tags.name: VMService
tags.description: VMService manages virtual machines and their QEMU lifecycle.

tags.name: HostService
tags.description: HostService exposes Linux host network information used by network functions.

tags.name: TroubleshootService
tags.description: TroubleshootService exposes VPP topology and ACL diagnostics.

tags.name: CaptureService
tags.description:
CaptureService manages VPP pcap traces and retained capture metadata.
The pcap download itself remains a native streaming HTTP endpoint.

replace_interface_ids.description:
Explicit replacement lets clients clear the interface set. Disks cannot
be cleared because every VM requires at least one disk.
